# use-js

RustUse js utilities and facade crate.

## Facade links

- Canonical facade crate page: https://rustuse.org/use-js/
- Facade overview page: https://rustuse.org/facades/use-js/
- Workspace Rustdocs: https://rustuse.org/api/workspaces/use-js/
- Repository: https://github.com/RustUse/use-js
- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Parent RustUse links

- Primary site: https://rustuse.org/

## Full facade context
